Let $X$ and $Y$ be continuous random variables. 
Find the conditional variance $\textrm{Var}\big[Y \,|\, X=3\big]$ given that the conditional probability density function $f_{Y|X}(y \,|\, 3)$ is shown above and the corresponding expected value is $\mu_{Y|3}=\dfrac{3}{2}.$
question.worked_solution:
Recall that the conditional variance of $Y$ given $X=x$ is defined by

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[Y\,|\,X=x] & =\text{E}[(Y-{\mu }_{Y|x})^{2}\,|\,X=x] \\  & =\text{E}[{Y}^{2}\,|\,X=x]-{\mu }_{Y|x}^{2},\end{aligned}
$$

where 

$$
\textrm{E}\big[Y^2 \,| \, X=x \big] = \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} y^2 \, f_{Y|X}(y \,|\, x) \: \textrm{d}y.
$$

Therefore, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[{Y}^{2}\,|\,X=3] & ={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }{y}^{2}\,{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,3)\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{\infty }{y}^{2}\cdot \frac{3}{{y}^{4}}\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{\infty }\frac{3}{{y}^{2}}\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{\infty }3{y}^{-2}\,\text{d}y \\  & ={[3\cdot \frac{{y}^{-1}}{(-1)}]}_{1}^{\infty } \\  & ={[-\frac{3}{y}]}_{1}^{\infty } \\  & =0-(-3) \\  & =3.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally,

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[Y\,|\,X=3] & =\text{E}[{Y}^{2}\,|\,X=3]-{\mu }_{Y|3}^{2} \\  & =3-{(\frac{3}{2})}^{2} \\  & =3-\frac{9}{4} \\  & =\frac{3}{4}.\end{aligned}
$$
